review_locator: PMCID:PMC7605919, GM-CSF: A Promising Target in Inflammation and Autoimmunity
primary_title: Granulocyte macrophage colony-stimulating factor and interleukin-5 activate STAT5 and induce CIS1 mRNA in human peripheral blood eosinophils
decision_basis: The review-guided primary reports rapid GM-CSF-induced STAT5 tyrosine phosphorylation and GAS DNA-binding activity in human peripheral-blood eosinophils.
limitations_preserved: Promote as an evidence-skipped GM-CSF/CSF2-to-STAT5 bridge alongside the existing CSF2RA:CSF2RB receptor-complex-to-STAT5 edge; preserve eosinophil context and do not infer terminal-TF status.

primary_title: Granulocyte macrophage colony-stimulating factor and interleukin-5 activate STAT5 and induce CIS1 mRNA in human peripheral blood eosinophils
decision_basis: The review-guided primary reports enhanced transcription of the STAT5-associated cytokine-inducible SH2 protein/CIS1 gene after GM-CSF stimulation of human peripheral-blood eosinophils.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded GM-CSF/CSF2-associated CISH gene-output bridge; preserve eosinophil and shared-beta-chain context without claiming exclusive STAT5 promoter control or terminal-TF status.
